page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; manuscript marks in the right margin and small stains at the left edge are not printed. Running head at top; page number top right; catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.l: re emptor pofsit, Res tua nō
nis fèper tã in emptore q̃ in
rò, qui unū et viginti accepit,
dū lex ait, Minus preciū est, si
foluta est: sic in emptore dicē-
dū est, Maius preciū est, si nec

page.notes: Right margin: manuscript annotations in ink, not printed text, so not transcribed. Left margin: stains and small marks, not printed. Corrections made: long s rendered as plain s; initial consonant u/i changed to v/j (iustū to justū is written as iustū with j, see below). Doubtful: "pofsetin" appears to be a run-together of "pofset in" as printed; kept as printed. Page is mid-sentence at the start, so the first paragraph continues from the previous page.
